behavior: Fan out swings whole sectors and their labels together with more overlap between staggered starts. Grid and Circular popups ignore outside taps and Back; a Grid footer Close button and the Circular center close explicitly. Invalid wheel-corner taps no longer close it. Pane/ownership changes still cancel the old menu.
